title: Harden ClamAV installer health and diagnostics

context.summary: Make ClamAV installer behavior observable and diagnosable for sync and async modes.
context.background: A public installer must tell the user exactly why ClamAV startup, platform selection or scan health failed.

in: Add ClamAV dependency and health checks to installer startup.
Add retry policy, timeout configuration and platform diagnostics.
Surface clear failure messages for daemon unavailable, timeout and scan protocol errors.
Add installer tests for async_quarantine and sync_scan modes.
Update installer, deployment and security docs.

acceptance_criteria: Installer validates ClamAV health when antivirus is enabled.
Diagnostics distinguish daemon unavailable, protocol failure and infected scan result.
ClamAV platform override is tested and documented.
Failed ClamAV health stops startup with a repairable message.

manual_checks: Confirm ClamAV diagnostics are actionable for Docker Desktop users.

risks: Health checks must not mask real scan failures as installation success.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
